summary: International Battery Metals filed an 8-K reporting a non-brokered private placement of 34.3 million units at $0.08/unit for $2.8M gross proceeds, each unit consisting of one common share and a four-year warrant to purchase an additional share at C$0.148. The subscriber, EV Metals 9 LLC, is an affiliate of a company director. This is a follow-on investment under a prior LOI. No conversion premium, board recommendation, or special-situation event is present; it is a routine capital raise. What to watch: potential dilution from warrant exercise.
